title: Evaluation of scalar multiplication
statement: Let $F$ be a commutative ring, let $\iota$ be a type of input wires, and assign each input $i$ a value $v(i)\in F$. For every circuit $a$ and scalar $c\in F$, the circuit obtained by multiplying $a$ by the public constant $c$ evaluates to $c$ times the value of $a$.
